changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION landvault_detect_estate_conflicts( p_estate_id uuid, p_min_overlap_sqm numeric ) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ WITH candidate AS ( SELECT LEAST(s.id, e.id) AS left_id, GREATEST(s.id, e.id) AS right_id, CASE WHEN s.id < e.id THEN s.tenant_id ELSE e.tenant_id END AS left_tenant, CASE WHEN s.id < e.id THEN e.tenant_id ELSE s.tenant_id END AS right_tenant, ST_Area(ST_Intersection(s.footprint, e.footprint)::geography)::numeric AS overlap_sqm, CASE WHEN s.id < e.id THEN ST_Area(s.footprint::geography)::numeric ELSE ST_Area(e.footprint::geography)::numeric END AS left_sqm, CASE WHEN s.id < e.id THEN ST_Area(e.footprint::geography)::numeric ELSE ST_Area(s.footprint::geography)::numeric END AS right_sqm, (s.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.tenant_id) AS cross_tenant FROM estates s JOIN estates e ON e.id <> s.id AND e.deleted = false AND e.footprint IS NOT NULL -- Index-backed candidate narrowing ONLY. Not the decision. AND ST_Intersects(s.footprint, e.footprint) WHERE s.id = p_estate_id AND s.deleted = false AND s.footprint IS NOT NULL ), -- The decision: real shared area in square metres, above the -- sliver threshold. Two estates meeting along a boundary -- produce an intersection of zero area and never reach here. real_overlap AS ( SELECT * FROM candidate WHERE overlap_sqm > p_min_overlap_sqm ), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO listing_conflicts ( id, created_at, created_by, deleted, conflict_type, left_entity_id, right_entity_id, left_tenant_id, right_tenant_id, estate_id, overlap_area_sqm, left_overlap_pct, right_overlap_pct, severity, status, detected_at ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'detection', false, 'ESTATE_OVERLAP', left_id, right_id, left_tenant, right_tenant, NULL, round(overlap_sqm, 2), round(LEAST(overlap_sqm / NULLIF(left_sqm, 0) * 100, 100), 2), round(LEAST(overlap_sqm / NULLIF(right_sqm, 0) * 100, 100), 2), CASE WHEN cross_tenant THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END, 'OPEN', now() FROM real_overlap ON CONFLICT (conflict_type, left_entity_id, right_entity_id) WHERE deleted = false AND status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING', 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') DO UPDATE SET overlap_area_sqm = EXCLUDED.overlap_area_sqm, left_overlap_pct = EXCLUDED.left_overlap_pct, right_overlap_pct = EXCLUDED.right_overlap_pct, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, -- A genuine re-overlap after a previous clearance -- means that clearance was stale (or reversed) — -- withdraw the signal rather than leave a false -- "this looked fixed" mark on an actively -- overlapping conflict. geometry_cleared_at = NULL, updated_at = now() -- status is deliberately absent: CD-8. A Super Admin -- halfway through an investigation keeps it through a -- re-scan. RETURNING 1 ), -- CD-9, MEDIUM only. Same tenant, nobody at risk of paying -- the wrong party — the geometry signal is trusted alone, -- same as the plain reading of CD-9 intended. The record is -- kept and marked, never deleted. auto_resolved_medium AS ( UPDATE listing_conflicts c SET status = 'AUTO_RESOLVED', resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now(), resolution_reason = 'Boundary geometry no longer overlaps. ' || 'Resolved automatically when detection re-ran.' WHERE c.conflict_type = 'ESTATE_OVERLAP' AND c.deleted = false AND c.severity = 'MEDIUM' AND c.status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING') AND (c.left_entity_id = p_estate_id OR c.right_entity_id = p_estate_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM real_overlap r WHERE r.left_id = c.left_entity_id AND r.right_id = c.right_entity_id ) RETURNING 1 ), -- HIGH, or anything a human has confirmed a duplicate at -- any severity: geometry alone must never lift the block. -- Record the clearance; leave status untouched, so the -- publication summary function (which counts by status, -- not by this column) is completely unaffected until a -- Super Admin reviews and dismisses it. geometry_cleared AS ( UPDATE listing_conflicts c SET geometry_cleared_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE c.conflict_type = 'ESTATE_OVERLAP' AND c.deleted = false AND (c.severity = 'HIGH' OR c.status = 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') AND c.status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING', 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') AND c.geometry_cleared_at IS NULL AND (c.left_entity_id = p_estate_id OR c.right_entity_id = p_estate_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM real_overlap r WHERE r.left_id = c.left_entity_id AND r.right_id = c.right_entity_id ) RETURNING 1 ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted)::integer; $$;

changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION landvault_detect_plot_conflicts( p_estate_id uuid, p_min_overlap_sqm numeric ) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ WITH candidate AS ( SELECT p1.id AS left_id, p2.id AS right_id, p1.tenant_id AS left_tenant, p2.tenant_id AS right_tenant, ST_Area(ST_Intersection(p1.footprint, p2.footprint)::geography)::numeric AS overlap_sqm, ST_Area(p1.footprint::geography)::numeric AS left_sqm, ST_Area(p2.footprint::geography)::numeric AS right_sqm FROM plots p1 JOIN plots p2 ON p1.id < p2.id AND p2.estate_id = p_estate_id AND p2.deleted = false AND p2.footprint IS NOT NULL -- Index-backed narrowing only; the threshold decides. AND ST_Intersects(p1.footprint, p2.footprint) WHERE p1.estate_id = p_estate_id AND p1.deleted = false AND p1.footprint IS NOT NULL ), real_overlap AS ( SELECT * FROM candidate WHERE overlap_sqm > p_min_overlap_sqm ), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO listing_conflicts ( id, created_at, created_by, deleted, conflict_type, left_entity_id, right_entity_id, left_tenant_id, right_tenant_id, estate_id, overlap_area_sqm, left_overlap_pct, right_overlap_pct, severity, status, detected_at ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'detection', false, 'PLOT_OVERLAP', left_id, right_id, left_tenant, right_tenant, p_estate_id, round(overlap_sqm, 2), round(LEAST(overlap_sqm / NULLIF(left_sqm, 0) * 100, 100), 2), round(LEAST(overlap_sqm / NULLIF(right_sqm, 0) * 100, 100), 2), 'MEDIUM', 'OPEN', now() FROM real_overlap ON CONFLICT (conflict_type, left_entity_id, right_entity_id) WHERE deleted = false AND status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING', 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') DO UPDATE SET overlap_area_sqm = EXCLUDED.overlap_area_sqm, left_overlap_pct = EXCLUDED.left_overlap_pct, right_overlap_pct = EXCLUDED.right_overlap_pct, geometry_cleared_at = NULL, updated_at = now() RETURNING 1 ), -- Plot conflicts are always same-tenant by construction, so -- always MEDIUM — the geometry signal is trusted alone here, -- UNLESS a human has separately confirmed one a duplicate, -- which is the one way a plot conflict can still need a -- human to release it. See the estate function's header -- comment for the full reasoning. auto_resolved_medium AS ( UPDATE listing_conflicts c SET status = 'AUTO_RESOLVED', resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now(), resolution_reason = 'Plot geometry no longer overlaps. ' || 'Resolved automatically when detection re-ran.' WHERE c.conflict_type = 'PLOT_OVERLAP' AND c.deleted = false AND c.estate_id = p_estate_id AND c.status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM real_overlap r WHERE r.left_id = c.left_entity_id AND r.right_id = c.right_entity_id ) RETURNING 1 ), geometry_cleared AS ( UPDATE listing_conflicts c SET geometry_cleared_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE c.conflict_type = 'PLOT_OVERLAP' AND c.deleted = false AND c.estate_id = p_estate_id AND c.status = 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE' AND c.geometry_cleared_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM real_overlap r WHERE r.left_id = c.left_entity_id AND r.right_id = c.right_entity_id ) RETURNING 1 ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted)::integer; $$;

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION landvault_tenant_estate_conflicts( p_estate_id uuid, p_tenant_id uuid ) RETURNS TABLE ( conflict_id uuid, conflict_type varchar, own_entity_id uuid, overlap_area_sqm numeric, own_overlap_pct numeric, severity varchar, status varchar, -- Non-null once a correction has been detected but not yet -- reviewed. Lets the tenant see "we noticed" without this -- function ever selecting anything about the other party — -- see changeset 046's column comment. geometry_cleared_at timestamptz, detected_at timestamptz ) LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT c.id, c.conflict_type, CASE WHEN c.left_tenant_id = p_tenant_id THEN c.left_entity_id ELSE c.right_entity_id END, c.overlap_area_sqm, CASE WHEN c.left_tenant_id = p_tenant_id THEN c.left_overlap_pct ELSE c.right_overlap_pct END, c.severity, c.status, c.geometry_cleared_at, c.detected_at FROM listing_conflicts c WHERE c.deleted = false -- The estate must actually be this tenant's, checked here -- rather than trusted of the caller. AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estates e WHERE e.id = p_estate_id AND e.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND e.deleted = false ) AND ( -- an estate-level conflict involving this estate (c.conflict_type = 'ESTATE_OVERLAP' AND (c.left_entity_id = p_estate_id OR c.right_entity_id = p_estate_id)) -- or a plot-level conflict inside it OR (c.conflict_type = 'PLOT_OVERLAP' AND c.estate_id = p_estate_id) ) -- Belt and braces: one side must be this tenant regardless. AND (c.left_tenant_id = p_tenant_id OR c.right_tenant_id = p_tenant_id) ORDER BY CASE c.severity WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.overlap_area_sqm DESC; $$;

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION landvault_estate_conflict_summary(p_estate_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE (blocking_count integer, warning_count integer) LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE c.severity = 'HIGH' OR c.status = 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE' )::integer, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE c.severity = 'MEDIUM' AND c.status <> 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE' )::integer FROM listing_conflicts c WHERE c.deleted = false AND c.status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING', 'CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE') AND ( (c.conflict_type = 'ESTATE_OVERLAP' AND (c.left_entity_id = p_estate_id OR c.right_entity_id = p_estate_id)) OR (c.conflict_type = 'PLOT_OVERLAP' AND c.estate_id = p_estate_id) ); $$;
